scope: Four synthetic requests, paired existing-source and upgraded-source instruction trials. Criteria recorded before inspecting generated outputs. These are targeted regressions, not an independent efficacy or authorship study.
criteria: Factual and scientific fidelity: retain quantity owners, aggregation type, negation, conditions, uncertainty and experimental status; add no unsupported claim.
Task compliance: preserve requested output language and scope. Cleanup preserves structure and unmatched wording; grammar-only changes stay grammatical.
Restraint: clear source sentences may remain unchanged; no unsolicited source search, disclosure, placeholders or second rewrite.
Readability: make only useful expression changes; preference may be a tie when both outputs meet the request.

case_focus.AH01: Correctly attach 11 and 8 errors, 310 and 345 ms median latency to baseline and adapted method, respectively, within the 120-query offline English set; do not invent significance, multilingual or online findings.
case_focus.AH02: Remove empty importance framing only, with necessary sentence-initial capitalization; preserve all remaining wording, LaTeX, statistical roles and reproducibility settings.
case_focus.AH03: The input is already clear. Preserve the scientific distinctions between consistency, optimality and evaluated scope; unchanged prose is acceptable.
case_focus.AH04: Fix subject–verb agreement only, retaining modality, dataset scope and untested online status.

review_format: For each case report A and B fidelity/compliance, any concrete issue, preference A/B/tie with reasons. Do not infer hidden condition identity.
